I think the Battle Camera was incompatible with a lot of scripts so MOG dropped it.
His/Her old site shows the script from the wayback machine
here

If someone from a Japanese community can ask for someone to share it if they have it might be the only option as no one has replied yet saying they have it, and MOG does not have it in his/her master demo - even though a lot of code was written with it in mind.
